title: Add async aget_conn and acreate_agent to PydanticAIHook
decision: `aget_conn()` and `acreate_agent()` run the unchanged `get_conn()` / `create_agent()` on a single-worker executor of the hook module
why: From any thread other than the loop's, a synchronous `send()` waits for the in-flight `asend()` to release the comms lock instead of raising, so fallback chains, `spec_file`, model-id qualification and subclass overrides behave exactly as in the sync path
